  1074	    """Load, authenticate, and freeze exactly one ledger snapshot.
  1075	
  1076	    A proper physical prefix of the pin is classified explicitly as rollback;
  1077	    any other physical/pinned disagreement is a stale-head mismatch.  The
  1078	    baseline must occur at its exact sequence in the same complete chain.
  1079	    This closes workflow omission, unregistered evidence, and rollback or
  1080	    stale-head consumption; it does not defend against a malicious trusted
  1081	    writer or a rewrite of both Git and the full ledger history.
  1082	    """
  1083	
  1084	    ledger_path = Path(ledger_path)
  1085	    head_pin_path = Path(head_pin_path)
  1086	    reasons: set[str] = set()
  1087	    try:
  1088	        pin_raw = head_pin_path.read_bytes()
  1089	        pin_value = json.loads(pin_raw)
  1090	    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
  1091	        pin_raw = b""
  1092	        pin_value = None
  1093	    pin = _head_pin(pin_value)
  1094	    if pin is None:
  1095	        reasons.add("calibration_ledger_malformed")
  1096	        pinned_sequence, pinned_digest = 0, GENESIS_DIGEST
  1097	    else:
  1098	        pinned_sequence, pinned_digest = pin
  1099	    try:
  1100	        raw = ledger_path.read_bytes()
  1101	    except OSError:
  1102	        raw = b""
  1103	        if pinned_sequence > 0:
  1104	            reasons.add("calibration_ledger_missing")
  1105	    genesis_development_bootstrap = (
  1106	        pinned_sequence == 0
  1107	        and pinned_digest == GENESIS_DIGEST
  1108	        and not raw
  1109	        and not ledger_path.exists()
  1110	    )
  1111	    if (
  1112	        require_committed_pin
  1113	        # The checked-in fixture starts at genesis.  Before its first commit,
  1114	        # an absent physical ledger cannot license a claim (there are no
  1115	        # endpoints); permitting this development-only empty view avoids a
  1116	        # circular "commit before tests" bootstrap. Any physical byte or any
  1117	        # non-genesis pin remains strictly commit-authenticated.
  1118	        and not genesis_development_bootstrap
  1119	        and _committed_pin_bytes(head_pin_path, repo_root) != pin_raw
  1120	    ):
  1121	        reasons.add("calibration_ledger_head_uncommitted")
  1122	    receipts, parse_reasons = _parse_ledger(raw)
  1123	    reasons.update(parse_reasons)
  1124	    physical_sequence = len(receipts)
  1125	    physical_digest = (
  1126	        str(receipts[-1]["receipt_digest"]) if receipts else GENESIS_DIGEST
  1127	    )
  1128	    if (physical_sequence, physical_digest) != (pinned_sequence, pinned_digest):
  1129	        if physical_sequence < pinned_sequence:
  1130	            reasons.add("calibration_ledger_rollback")
  1131	        else:
  1132	            reasons.add("calibration_ledger_head_mismatch")
  1133	    if baseline_sequence is not None or baseline_digest is not None:
  1134	        if (
  1135	            isinstance(baseline_sequence, bool)
  1136	            or not isinstance(baseline_sequence, int)
  1137	            or baseline_sequence < 0
  1138	            or not _is_sha256(baseline_digest)
  1139	        ):
  1140	            reasons.add("calibration_ledger_baseline_missing")
  1141	        else:
  1142	            in_chain = (
  1143	                baseline_digest == GENESIS_DIGEST
  1144	                if baseline_sequence == 0
  1145	                else baseline_sequence <= len(receipts)
  1146	                and receipts[baseline_sequence - 1]["receipt_digest"]
  1147	                == baseline_digest
  1148	            )
  1149	            if not in_chain or baseline_sequence > pinned_sequence:
  1150	                reasons.add("calibration_ledger_baseline_missing")
  1151	    observations, bracket_sessions, state_reasons = _attempts_and_observations(
  1152	        receipts
  1153	    )
  1154	    reasons.update(state_reasons)
  1155	    if verify_custody:
  1156	        custody_observations = list(observations)
  1157	        custody_attempt_ids = {observation.attempt_id for observation in observations}
  1158	        for session in bracket_sessions:
  1159	            custody_observations.extend(
  1160	                observation
  2060	        try:
  2061	            os.close(lock_descriptor)
  2062	        except OSError:
  2063	            pass
  2064	    return plan

  2067	def _locked_append(
  2068	    ledger_path: Path,
  2069	    build: Any,
  2070	) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
  2071	    ledger_path = Path(ledger_path)
  2072	    ledger_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  2073	    lock_descriptor = _open_ledger_lock(ledger_path)
  2074	    try:
  2075	        fcntl.flock(lock_descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
  2076	        descriptor = os.open(
  2077	            ledger_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o600
  2078	        )
  2079	        try:
  2080	            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "r+b", closefd=False) as handle:
  2081	                handle.seek(0)
  2082	                raw = handle.read()
  2083	                receipts, reasons = _parse_ledger(raw)
  2084	                if reasons:
  2085	                    raise CalibrationLedgerError(", ".join(sorted(reasons)))
  2086	                receipt = build(receipts)
  2087	                if not _valid_receipt_shape(receipt):
  2088	                    raise CalibrationLedgerError(
  2089	                        "writer constructed a malformed receipt"
  2090	                    )
  2091	                payload = canonical_json_bytes(receipt) + b"\n"
  2092	                handle.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
  2093	                handle.write(payload)
  2094	                handle.flush()
  2095	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
  2096	                return _frozen_mapping(receipt)
  2097	        finally:
  2098	            os.close(descriptor)
  2099	    finally:
  2100	        os.close(lock_descriptor)

  2103	def _authenticated_head_pin(
  2104	    head_pin_path: Path,
  2105	    *,
  2106	    require_committed_pin: bool,
  2107	    repo_root: Path,
  2108	) -> tuple[int, str]:
  2109	    pin_path = Path(head_pin_path)
  2110	    try:
  2111	        pin_raw = pin_path.read_bytes()
  2112	        pin_value = json.loads(pin_raw)
  2113	    except (OSError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError) as exc:
  2114	        raise CalibrationLedgerError("head pin is unreadable") from exc
  2115	    pin = _head_pin(pin_value)
  2116	    if pin is None:
  2117	        raise CalibrationLedgerError("head pin is malformed")
  2118	    if require_committed_pin and _committed_pin_bytes(pin_path, repo_root) != pin_raw:
  2119	        raise CalibrationLedgerError("head pin is not committed at Git HEAD")

  2123	def append_bracket_session_receipt(
  2124	    ledger_path: Path,

  2149	        "evidence_root_id": evidence_root_id,

  2160	            "custody_locator": source.get("custody_locator"),
  2161	            "identity_epoch": _normalized_vector(
  2162	                source.get("identity_epoch"), IDENTITY_EPOCH_FIELDS
  2163	            ),
  2164	            "t1_bindings": _normalized_vector(source.get("t1_bindings"), T1_FIELDS),
  2165	            "expected_time_role": role,
  2166	        }

  2170	    ):

  2179	        require_committed_pin=require_committed_pin,
  2180	        repo_root=Path(repo_root),
  2181	    )

  2186	            raise CalibrationLedgerError(
  2187	                "physical ledger head differs from the committed pin"
  2188	            )

  2190	        del observations
  2191	        if reasons:
  2192	            raise CalibrationLedgerError(", ".join(sorted(reasons)))

  2194	            attempt_id
  2195	            for session in sessions
  2196	            for attempt_id in session.slot_attempt_ids.values()

  2200	            for receipt in receipts
  2201	            if receipt.get("schema_version") == RECEIPT_SCHEMA

  2222	def finalize_bracket_session_slot(

  2227	    disposition: str,

  2248	        del observations

  2250	        if non_open_reasons:
  2251	            raise CalibrationLedgerError(", ".join(sorted(non_open_reasons)))

  2259	                f"bracket session slot must finalize in order: expected {expected_slot}"
  2260	            )

  2262	            receipt
  2263	            for receipt in receipts

  2278	            sequence=len(receipts) + 1,
  2279	            predecessor_digest=str(predecessor),
  2280	            event=BRACKET_SESSION_FINALIZATION_EVENT,
  2281	            session_identity={
  2282	                field: open_receipt[field] for field in _SESSION_IDENTITY_KEYS
  2283	            },
  2284	            fields={
  2285	                "slot": slot,
  2286	                "attempt_id": reserved["attempt_id"],
  2287	                "content_id": content_id,

  2289	                "identity_epoch": normalized_epoch,
  2290	                "t1_bindings": normalized_t1,
  2291	                "capture_wall_time_s": capture_wall_time_s,
  2292	                "exact_bound_lexeme_s": exact_bound_lexeme_s,
  2293	                "disposition": disposition,
  2294	                "custody_locator": custody_locator,
  2295	            },
  2296	        )

  2301	def abort_bracket_session(
  2302	    ledger_path: Path,
  2303	    *,
  2304	    session_id: str,
  2305	    reason: str,
  2306	) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
  2307	    """Append a governed terminal closure without deleting partial receipts."""
  2308

  2310	        raise CalibrationLedgerError("bracket session abort reason must be nonempty")
  2311	
  2312	    def build(receipts: Sequence[Mapping[str, Any]]) -> Mapping[str, Any]:

  2314	        del observations

  2317	            raise CalibrationLedgerError(", ".join(sorted(non_open_reasons)))

  2319	            (item for item in sessions if item.session_id == session_id), None

  2321	        if session is None or session.state != "open":
  2322	            raise CalibrationLedgerError("bracket session is not open")
  2323	        open_receipt = next(
  2324	            receipt
  2325	            for receipt in receipts
  2326	            if receipt.get("event") == BRACKET_SESSION_OPEN_EVENT
  2327	            and receipt.get("session_id") == session_id
  2328	        )
  2329	        predecessor = receipts[-1]["receipt_digest"] if receipts else GENESIS_DIGEST
  2330	        finalized_slots = list(session.finalized_slots)

  2332	            sequence=len(receipts) + 1,
  2333	            predecessor_digest=str(predecessor),
  2334	            event=BRACKET_SESSION_ABORT_EVENT,
  2335	            session_identity={
  2336	                field: open_receipt[field] for field in _SESSION_IDENTITY_KEYS
  2337	            },
  2338	            fields={
  2339	                "finalized_slots": finalized_slots,
  2340	                "unused_slots": [
  2341	                    role for role in BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS if role not in finalized_slots
  2342	                ],
  2343	                "reason": reason,

  2350	def terminal_head_pin_for_session(
  2351	    ledger_path: Path,

  1042	def _custody_reasons(
  1043	    observations: Sequence[LedgerObservation], repo_root: Path
  1044	) -> set[str]:
  1045	    for observation in observations:
  1046	        if not observation.artifact_sha256:
  1047	            if observation.disposition == "abandoned":
  1048	                continue
  1049	            return {"calibration_ledger_custody_invalid"}

  1051	        if not root.is_absolute():
  1052	            root = Path(repo_root) / root

  1054	            path = root / relative

  1056	                actual = hashlib.sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
  1057	            except OSError:
  1058	                return {"calibration_ledger_custody_invalid"}
  1059	            if actual != expected:
  1060	                return {"calibration_ledger_custody_invalid"}
  1061	    return set()

  2067	def _locked_append(
  2068	    ledger_path: Path,
  2069	    build: Any,
  2070	) -> Mapping[str, Any]:
  2071	    ledger_path = Path(ledger_path)
  2072	    ledger_path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
  2073	    lock_descriptor = _open_ledger_lock(ledger_path)
  2074	    try:
  2075	        fcntl.flock(lock_descriptor, fcntl.LOCK_EX)
  2076	        descriptor = os.open(
  2077	            ledger_path, os.O_RDWR | os.O_CREAT | os.O_APPEND, 0o600
  2078	        )
  2079	        try:
  2080	            with os.fdopen(descriptor, "r+b", closefd=False) as handle:
  2081	                handle.seek(0)
  2082	                raw = handle.read()
  2083	                receipts, reasons = _parse_ledger(raw)
  2084	                if reasons:
  2085	                    raise CalibrationLedgerError(", ".join(sorted(reasons)))
  2086	                receipt = build(receipts)
  2087	                if not _valid_receipt_shape(receipt):
  2088	                    raise CalibrationLedgerError(
  2089	                        "writer constructed a malformed receipt"
  2090	                    )
  2091	                payload = canonical_json_bytes(receipt) + b"\n"
  2092	                handle.seek(0, os.SEEK_END)
  2093	                handle.write(payload)
  2094	                handle.flush()
  2095	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
  2096	                return _frozen_mapping(receipt)
  2097	        finally:
  2098	            os.close(descriptor)
  2099	    finally:
  2100	        os.close(lock_descriptor)

   288	def _validate_reserved_bracket_slot(
   289	    ledger_path: Path,
   290	    head_pin_path: Path,
   291	    *,
   292	    session_id: str,
   293	    slot: str,
   294	    attempt_id: str,
   295	    custody_locator: str,
   296	    identity_epoch: Mapping[str, Any],
   297	    t1_bindings: Mapping[str, Any],
   298	    require_committed_pin: bool = True,
   299	) -> None:
   300	    """Authenticate the exact predeclared slot before capture state exists."""
   301	
   302	    snapshot = load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
   303	        ledger_path,
   304	        head_pin_path,
   305	        require_committed_pin=require_committed_pin,
   306	        verify_custody=True,
   307	    )
   308	    session = snapshot.bracket_session_by_id.get(session_id)
   309	    finalized_slots = set(session.finalized_slots) if session is not None else set()
   310	    expected_slot = (
   311	        "pre"
   312	        if not finalized_slots
   313	        else "post"
   314	        if finalized_slots == {"pre"}
   315	        else None
   316	    )
   317	    open_receipt = next(
   318	        (
   319	            receipt
   320	            for receipt in snapshot.receipts
   321	            if receipt.get("schema_version") == BRACKET_SESSION_SCHEMA
   322	            and receipt.get("event") == BRACKET_SESSION_OPEN_EVENT
   323	            and receipt.get("session_id") == session_id
   324	        ),
   325	        None,
   326	    )
   327	    reserved = (
   328	        open_receipt.get("slots", {}).get(slot)
   329	        if isinstance(open_receipt, Mapping)
   330	        and isinstance(open_receipt.get("slots"), Mapping)
   331	        else None
   332	    )
   333	    if (
   334	        not snapshot.is_governed_open_bracket_extension
   335	        or session is None
   336	        or session.state != "open"
   337	        or slot not in BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS

   345	    ):

   107	            # exact acceptance lexeme and its explicit binary64 projection.

   109	            "b_fiducial_decimal_s": str(bound) if bound is not None else None,

   111	            "content_id": self.content_id,
   112	            "ledger_receipt_digest": self.ledger_receipt_digest,
   113	            "bracket_session_id": self.bracket_session_id,
   114	            "bracket_slot": self.bracket_slot,
   115	            "bracket_window_id": self.bracket_window_id,
   116	            "bracket_plan_id": self.bracket_plan_id,
   117	            "bracket_plan_sha256": self.bracket_plan_sha256,
   118	            "bracket_evidence_root_id": self.bracket_evidence_root_id,

   122	def _canonical_sha256(value: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
   123	    raw = json.dumps(
   124	        dict(value),
   125	        sort_keys=True,
   126	        separators=(",", ":"),
   127	        ensure_ascii=False,
   128	        allow_nan=False,
   129	    ).encode("utf-8")
   130	    return hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()
   131	
   132	
   133	def _decimal(value: Any) -> Decimal | None:
   134	    if not isinstance(value, str) or not value:
   135	        return None
   136	    try:
   137	        result = Decimal(value)
   138	    except InvalidOperation:
   139	        return None
   140	    return result if result.is_finite() else None
   141	
   142	
   143	def _candidate_decimal(candidate: CalibrationCandidate) -> Decimal | None:
   144	    value = candidate.b_fiducial_s
   145	    if isinstance(value, Decimal):
   146	        result = value
   147	    elif isinstance(value, str):
   148	        result = _decimal(value)
   149	        if result is None:
   150	            return None
   151	    elif (
   152	        isinstance(value, int | float)
   153	        and not isinstance(value, bool)
   154	        and math.isfinite(float(value))
   155	    ):
   156	        # Compatibility for synthetic callers that predate D-102. Production
   157	        # candidates carry strings from authenticated evidence bytes instead.
   158	        result = Decimal(str(value))
   159	    else:
   160	        return None
   161	    return result if result.is_finite() else None
   162

   164	def _current_estimator_code_sha256() -> dict[str, str] | None:
   165	    try:
   166	        return {
   167	            relative: hashlib.sha256((_REPO_ROOT / relative).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
   168	            for relative in ESTIMATOR_CODE_PATHS
   169	        }
   170	    except OSError:
   171	        return None

   174	def _valid_acceptance_bound(value: Any) -> bool:
   175	    """Validate the D-102 artifact from its decimal-source member table."""
   176	
   177	    if not isinstance(value, Mapping):
   178	        return False
   179	    core = {key: item for key, item in value.items() if key != "derivation_sha256"}
   180	    identity = value.get("identity_epoch")
   181	    prospective = value.get("prospective_rederivation")
   182	    corpus = value.get("derivation_corpus")
   183	    prior = value.get("prior_observation_set")
   184	    cutoff = value.get("ledger_cutoff")
   185	    issuance = value.get("issuance")
   186	    backfill = value.get("backfill_candidate")
   187	    derivation = value.get("decimal_derivation")
   188	    role = value.get("artifact_role")
   189	    if role == "schema_fixture_unissued":
   190	        role_valid = (
   191	            value.get("schema_version") == ACCEPTANCE_FIXTURE_SCHEMA
   192	            and isinstance(issuance, Mapping)
   193	            and issuance.get("status") == "unratified_fixture"
   194	            and issuance.get("claim_eligible") is False
   195	            and isinstance(cutoff, Mapping)
   196	            and cutoff.get("sequence") == 0
   197	            and cutoff.get("head_digest") == "0" * 64
   198	            and cutoff.get("role")
   199	            == "fixture_genesis_not_a_production_issuance_cutoff"
   200	            and isinstance(backfill, Mapping)
   201	            and backfill.get("status") == "unratified_candidate_only"
   202	            and backfill.get("production_issuance_blocked") is True
   203	        )
   204	        allowed_prior_dispositions = {
   205	            "valid",
   206	            "systematic-invalid",
   207	            "ordinary-invalid",
   208	            "blind-holdout",
   209	            "unresolved",
   210	        }
   211	    elif role == "issued":
   212	        role_valid = (
   213	            value.get("schema_version") == ACCEPTANCE_BOUND_SCHEMA
   214	            and isinstance(issuance, Mapping)
   215	            and issuance.get("status") == "issued"
   216	            and issuance.get("claim_eligible") is True
   217	            and isinstance(cutoff, Mapping)
   218	            and isinstance(cutoff.get("sequence"), int)
   219	            and not isinstance(cutoff.get("sequence"), bool)
   220	            and cutoff.get("sequence") > 0
   221	            and _valid_sha256(cutoff.get("head_digest"))
   222	            and cutoff.get("head_digest") != "0" * 64
   223	            and cutoff.get("role") == "issued_acceptance_baseline"
   224	            and isinstance(backfill, Mapping)
   225	            and backfill.get("status") == "issued"
   226	            and backfill.get("production_issuance_blocked") is False
   227	        )
   228	        allowed_prior_dispositions = {
   229	            "valid",
   230	            "systematic-invalid",
   231	            "ordinary-invalid",
   232	        }
   233	    else:
   234	        return False
   235	    if (
   236	        not role_valid
   237	        or value.get("acceptance_id") != "d079_calibration_acceptance_v2_n19"
   238	        or value.get("decision_ids") != ["D-102", "D-109"]
   239	        or value.get("derivation_sha256") != _canonical_sha256(core)
   240	        or not isinstance(identity, Mapping)
   240	        or not isinstance(identity, Mapping)
   241	        or set(identity) != set(ACCEPTANCE_IDENTITY_FIELDS)
   242	        or any(identity.get(field) in (None, "") for field in ACCEPTANCE_IDENTITY_FIELDS)
   243	        or not isinstance(prospective, Mapping)
   244	        or prospective.get("calendar_expiry") is not None
   245	        or prospective.get("trigger_observation_rule")
   246	        != "judge_under_prior_artifact_never_self_fit"
   247	        or prospective.get("protocol_sha256") != protocol_sha256(PROTOCOL_ID)
   248	        or not isinstance(prospective.get("estimator_code_sha256"), Mapping)
   249	        or set(prospective["estimator_code_sha256"]) != set(ESTIMATOR_CODE_PATHS)
   250	        or any(
   251	            not _valid_sha256(item)
   252	            for item in prospective["estimator_code_sha256"].values()
   253	        )
   254	        or not isinstance(prospective.get("triggers"), list)
   255	        or set(prospective["triggers"])
   256	        != {
   257	            "identity_field_change",
   258	            "protocol_or_estimator_byte_change",
   259	            "new_valid_same_identity_capture_expands_observed_range",
   260	            "corpus_doubles_from_19_to_38",
   261	            "new_systematic_failure_challenges_preflight_screen",
   262	        }
   263	        or not isinstance(corpus, Mapping)
   264	        or corpus.get("n") != 19
   265	        or not isinstance(corpus.get("members"), list)
   266	        or len(corpus["members"]) != 19
   267	        or not isinstance(cutoff, Mapping)
   268	        or cutoff.get("ledger_schema") != LEDGER_SCHEMA
   269	        or not isinstance(prior, Mapping)
   270	        or prior.get("cutoff")
   271	        != {
   272	            "sequence": cutoff.get("sequence"),
   273	            "head_digest": cutoff.get("head_digest"),
   274	            "ledger_schema": cutoff.get("ledger_schema"),
   275	        }
   276	        or not isinstance(prior.get("epoch_catalog"), Mapping)
   277	        or set(prior["epoch_catalog"]) != {"d079_epoch"}
   278	        or prior["epoch_catalog"].get("d079_epoch") != identity
   279	        or not isinstance(prior.get("observations"), list)
   280	        or not isinstance(derivation, Mapping)
   281	        or derivation.get("numeric_semantics") != "decimal_source_lexemes"
   282	    ):
   283	        return False
   284	    member_ids: list[str] = []
   285	    values: list[Decimal] = []
   286	    for member in corpus["members"]:
   287	        if (
   288	            not isinstance(member, Mapping)
   289	            or set(member)
   290	            != {
   291	                "member_id",
   292	                "source_directory",
   293	                "b_fiducial_s",
   294	                "manifest_sha256",
   295	                "instrument_evidence_sha256",
   296	            }
   297	            or not isinstance(member.get("member_id"), str)
   298	            or not isinstance(member.get("source_directory"), str)
   299	            or not _valid_sha256(member.get("manifest_sha256"))
   300	            or not _valid_sha256(member.get("instrument_evidence_sha256"))
   301	        ):
   302	            return False
   303	        bound = _decimal(member.get("b_fiducial_s"))
   304	        if bound is None or bound < 0:
   305	            return False
   306	        member_ids.append(member["member_id"])
   307	        values.append(bound)
   308	    if len(set(member_ids)) != 19 or member_ids != sorted(member_ids):
   309	        return False
   310	
   311	    prior_ids: list[str] = []
   312	    prior_attempt_ids: list[str] = []
   313	    prior_member_ids: set[str] = set()
   314	    for observation in prior["observations"]:
   315	        if (
   316	            not isinstance(observation, Mapping)
   317	            or set(observation)
   318	            != {"content_id", "epoch_id", "disposition", "attempt_id"}
   319	            or not _valid_sha256(observation.get("content_id"))
   320	            or observation.get("epoch_id") != "d079_epoch"
   321	            or observation.get("disposition") not in allowed_prior_dispositions
   322	            or not isinstance(observation.get("attempt_id"), str)
   323	            or not observation.get("attempt_id")
   324	        ):
   325	            return False
   326	        prior_ids.append(observation["content_id"])
   327	        prior_attempt_ids.append(observation["attempt_id"])
   328	        if observation["attempt_id"] in member_ids:
   329	            prior_member_ids.add(observation["attempt_id"])
   330	    if (
   331	        len(prior_ids) != len(set(prior_ids))
   332	        or len(prior_attempt_ids) != len(set(prior_attempt_ids))
   333	        or prior_member_ids != set(member_ids)
   334	    ):
   335	        return False
   336	    if role == "issued":
   337	        disposition_counts = {
   338	            disposition: sum(
   339	                observation["disposition"] == disposition
   340	                for observation in prior["observations"]
   341	            )
   342	            for disposition in sorted(allowed_prior_dispositions)
   343	        }
   344	        if (
   345	            len(prior["observations"]) != 38
   346	            or cutoff["sequence"] != 2 * len(prior["observations"])
   347	            or backfill.get("candidate_inventory") != disposition_counts
   348	        ):
   349	            return False
   350	    member_content_ids = {
   351	        content_id_from_artifact_hashes(
   352	            {
   353	                "manifest.json": member["manifest_sha256"],
   354	                "instrument_evidence.json": member[
   355	                    "instrument_evidence_sha256"
   356	                ],
   357	            }
   358	        )
   359	        for member in corpus["members"]
   360	    }
   361	    if None in member_content_ids or not member_content_ids.issubset(set(prior_ids)):
   362	        return False
   363	
   364	    statistics = derivation.get("source_statistics")
   365	    rounding = derivation.get("rounding")
   366	    operatives = derivation.get("ratified_operatives")
   367	    if not all(isinstance(item, Mapping) for item in (statistics, rounding, operatives)):
   368	        return False
   369	    with localcontext() as context:
   370	        context.prec = 80
   371	        count = Decimal(len(values))
   372	        mean = sum(values, Decimal(0)) / count
   373	        sample_sd = (
   374	            sum((item - mean) ** 2 for item in values) / Decimal(len(values) - 1)
   375	        ).sqrt()
   376	        quantum = Decimal("0.000000000000000001")
   377	        expected_statistics = {
   378	            "minimum_s": str(min(values)),
   379	            "maximum_s": str(max(values)),
   380	            "range_s": str(max(values) - min(values)),
   381	            "mean_presentation_s": str(
   382	                mean.quantize(quantum, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
   383	            ),
   384	            "sample_sd_presentation_s": str(
   385	                sample_sd.quantize(quantum, rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN)
   386	            ),
   387	        }
   388	    minimum_id = member_ids[values.index(min(values))]
   389	    maximum_id = member_ids[values.index(max(values))]
   390	    if (
   391	        statistics.get("minimum_s") != expected_statistics["minimum_s"]
   392	        or statistics.get("maximum_s") != expected_statistics["maximum_s"]
   393	        or statistics.get("range_s") != expected_statistics["range_s"]
   394	        or statistics.get("minimum_member_id") != minimum_id
   395	        or statistics.get("maximum_member_id") != maximum_id
   396	        or not isinstance(statistics.get("mean_presentation_s"), Mapping)
   397	        or statistics["mean_presentation_s"].get("value")
   398	        != expected_statistics["mean_presentation_s"]
   399	        or statistics["mean_presentation_s"].get("label")
   400	        != "rounded_presentation"
   401	        or not isinstance(statistics.get("sample_sd_presentation_s"), Mapping)
   402	        or statistics["sample_sd_presentation_s"].get("value")
   403	        != expected_statistics["sample_sd_presentation_s"]
   404	        or statistics["sample_sd_presentation_s"].get("label")
   405	        != "rounded_presentation"
   406	        or statistics.get("prediction_95_two_draw_s")
   407	        != "0.008826584887500717"
   408	        or statistics.get("prediction_99_two_draw_s")
   409	        != "0.012093166090593858"
   410	        or rounding.get("mode") != "ROUND_HALF_EVEN"
   411	        or not isinstance(rounding.get("operative_bracket_screen"), Mapping)
   412	        or rounding["operative_bracket_screen"].get("quantum_s") != "0.000001"
   413	        or rounding["operative_bracket_screen"].get("value_s")
   414	        != _D102_OPERATIVE_VALUES["bracket_screen_s"]
   415	        or not isinstance(rounding.get("preflight_level_screen"), Mapping)

   417	        != "0.000000000000001"

   419	        != _D102_OPERATIVE_VALUES["preflight_level_screen_s"]

   421	        or operatives.get("allowance_rule")

   423	        or operatives.get("operative_bound_rule")

   430	    excess = Decimal(_D102_OPERATIVE_VALUES["max_budgetable_excess_s"])

   432	        (max(values) - min(values)).quantize(
   433	            Decimal("0.000001"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN
   434	        )
   435	        == screen
   436	        and max(values).quantize(
   437	            Decimal("0.000000000000001"), rounding=ROUND_HALF_EVEN
   438	        )
   439	        == Decimal(_D102_OPERATIVE_VALUES["preflight_level_screen_s"])
   440	        and screen + excess == maximum
   441	    )

   444	def load_calibration_acceptance_bound(
   445	    path: Path = DEFAULT_ACCEPTANCE_BOUND_PATH,
   446	) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
   447	    """Load the file-pinned D-102 acceptance artifact fail-closed."""
   448	
   449	    try:
   450	        raw = Path(path).read_bytes()
   451	    except OSError:
   452	        return None
   453	    return _acceptance_bound_from_authenticated_bytes(raw)
   454	
   455	
   456	def _acceptance_bound_from_authenticated_bytes(
   457	    raw: bytes,
   458	) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
   459	    """Parse acceptance bytes only when their role-indexed pin authenticates."""
   460	
   461	    try:
   462	        value = json.loads(raw)
   463	    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
   464	        return None
   465	    # Any file route is authenticated by one of the two reviewed exact-byte
   466	    # states: the genesis fixture retained for pre-issuance tests, or the
   467	    # deterministically emitted issued artifact. A caller cannot turn an
   468	    # alternate self-consistent document into authority by choosing a path.
   469	    expected_sha256 = {
   470	        "schema_fixture_unissued": DEFAULT_ACCEPTANCE_BOUND_SHA256,
   471	        "issued": ISSUED_ACCEPTANCE_BOUND_SHA256,
   472	    }.get(value.get("artifact_role") if isinstance(value, Mapping) else None)
   473	    if hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected_sha256:
   474	        return None
   475	    if not _valid_acceptance_bound(value):
   476	        return None
   477	    return dict(value)
   478	
   479	
   480	def _authenticated_explicit_acceptance_bound(
   481	    value: Mapping[str, Any],
   482	) -> dict[str, Any] | None:
   483	    """Authenticate an in-memory artifact against the checked-in byte pin."""
   484	
   485	    pinned = load_calibration_acceptance_bound()
   486	    if pinned is None or dict(value) != pinned:
   487	        return None
   488	    return pinned
   489	
   490	
   491	def _acceptance_artifact_sha256(artifact: Mapping[str, Any]) -> str:
   492	    """Return the reviewed exact-byte pin for a validated artifact role."""
   493	
   494	    return (
   495	        ISSUED_ACCEPTANCE_BOUND_SHA256
   496	        if artifact.get("artifact_role") == "issued"
   497	        else DEFAULT_ACCEPTANCE_BOUND_SHA256
   498	    )
   499	
   500	
   501	def _valid_sha256(value: Any) -> bool:
   502	    return (
   503	        isinstance(value, str)
   504	        and len(value) == 64
   505	        and all(char in "0123456789abcdef" for char in value)
   506	    )

   509	_BRACKET_BINDING_KEYS = {
   510	    "schema_version",
   511	    "ledger_schema",
   512	    "session_id",
   513	    "window_id",
   514	    "plan_id",
   515	    "plan_sha256",
   516	    "evidence_root_id",
   517	    "capability_receipt_digest",
   518	    "terminal_head",
   519	    "endpoints",
   520	    "binding_digest",

   523	    "attempt_id",
   524	    "receipt_digest",
   525	    "content_digest",

   529	def _binding_core(binding: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:
   530	    return {key: value for key, value in binding.items() if key != "binding_digest"}

   532	
   533	def build_calibration_bracket_binding(
   534	    ledger_snapshot: CalibrationLedgerSnapshot,
   535	    *,
   536	    session_id: str,
   537	    window_id: str,
   538	    plan_id: str,
   539	    plan_sha256: str,
   540	    evidence_root_id: str,
   541	) -> dict[str, Any]:
   542	    """Bind one frozen window to its exact finalized session endpoints."""
   543	
   544	    if not isinstance(ledger_snapshot, CalibrationLedgerSnapshot) or not ledger_snapshot.valid:
   545	        raise ValueError("bracket binding requires a valid pinned ledger snapshot")
   546	    session = ledger_snapshot.bracket_session_by_id.get(session_id)
   547	    expected_identity = (window_id, plan_id, plan_sha256, evidence_root_id)
   548	    if (
   549	        session is None
   550	        or session.state != "finalized"
   551	        or (
   552	            session.window_id,
   553	            session.plan_id,
   554	            session.plan_sha256,
   555	            session.evidence_root_id,
   556	        )
   557	        != expected_identity
   558	    ):
   559	        raise ValueError("bracket session does not match the frozen window identity")
   560	    pre = session.finalized_slots.get("pre")
   561	    post = session.finalized_slots.get("post")
   562	    if (
   563	        pre is None
   564	        or post is None
   565	        or pre.disposition != "valid"
   566	        or post.disposition != "valid"
   567	        or pre.content_id is None
   568	        or post.content_id is None
   569	        or post.sequence != ledger_snapshot.head_sequence
   570	        or post.receipt_digest != ledger_snapshot.head_digest
   571	    ):
   572	        raise ValueError("bracket session endpoints are not valid at the terminal head")
   573	    binding: dict[str, Any] = {
   574	        "schema_version": BRACKET_BINDING_SCHEMA,
   575	        "ledger_schema": LEDGER_SCHEMA,
   576	        "session_id": session.session_id,
   577	        "window_id": session.window_id,
   578	        "plan_id": session.plan_id,
   579	        "plan_sha256": session.plan_sha256,
   580	        "evidence_root_id": session.evidence_root_id,
   581	        "capability_receipt_digest": session.capability_receipt_digest,
   582	        "terminal_head": {
   583	            "sequence": post.sequence,
   584	            "head_digest": post.receipt_digest,
   585	            "ledger_schema": LEDGER_SCHEMA,
   586	        },
   587	        "endpoints": {
   588	            role: {
   589	                "attempt_id": observation.attempt_id,
   590	                "receipt_digest": observation.receipt_digest,
   591	                "content_digest": observation.content_id,
   592	            }
   593	            for role, observation in (("pre", pre), ("post", post))
   594	        },
   595	    }
   596	    binding["binding_digest"] = _canonical_sha256(binding)
   597	    return binding
   598	
   599	
   600	def validate_calibration_bracket_binding(
   601	    binding: Mapping[str, Any],
   602	    ledger_snapshot: CalibrationLedgerSnapshot,
   603	    *,
   604	    window_id: str | None = None,
   605	    plan_id: str | None = None,
   606	    plan_sha256: str | None = None,
   607	    evidence_root_id: str | None = None,
   608	) -> tuple[LedgerObservation, LedgerObservation] | None:
   609	    """Return the exact authenticated pair, or ``None`` on any substitution."""
   610	
   611	    if (
   612	        not isinstance(binding, Mapping)
   613	        or set(binding) != _BRACKET_BINDING_KEYS
   614	        or binding.get("schema_version") != BRACKET_BINDING_SCHEMA
   615	        or binding.get("ledger_schema") != LEDGER_SCHEMA
   616	        or not _valid_sha256(binding.get("plan_sha256"))
   617	        or not _valid_sha256(binding.get("capability_receipt_digest"))
   618	        or not _valid_sha256(binding.get("binding_digest"))
   619	        or binding.get("binding_digest") != _canonical_sha256(_binding_core(binding))
   620	        or not isinstance(ledger_snapshot, CalibrationLedgerSnapshot)
   621	        or not ledger_snapshot.valid
   622	    ):
   623	        return None
   624	    for field, expected in (
   625	        ("window_id", window_id),
   626	        ("plan_id", plan_id),
   627	        ("plan_sha256", plan_sha256),
   628	        ("evidence_root_id", evidence_root_id),

   631	            return None
   632	    session = ledger_snapshot.bracket_session_by_id.get(str(binding.get("session_id")))
   633	    if (
   634	        session is None
   635	        or session.state != "finalized"
   636	        or binding.get("window_id") != session.window_id
   637	        or binding.get("plan_id") != session.plan_id
   638	        or binding.get("plan_sha256") != session.plan_sha256
   639	        or binding.get("evidence_root_id") != session.evidence_root_id
   640	        or binding.get("capability_receipt_digest")
   641	        != session.capability_receipt_digest
   642	    ):
   643	        return None
   644	    terminal = binding.get("terminal_head")
   645	    endpoints = binding.get("endpoints")
   646	    if (
   647	        not isinstance(terminal, Mapping)
   648	        or set(terminal) != {"sequence", "head_digest", "ledger_schema"}
   649	        or terminal.get("ledger_schema") != LEDGER_SCHEMA
   650	        or isinstance(terminal.get("sequence"), bool)
   650	        or isinstance(terminal.get("sequence"), bool)
   651	        or not isinstance(terminal.get("sequence"), int)
   652	        or not _valid_sha256(terminal.get("head_digest"))
   653	        or not isinstance(endpoints, Mapping)
   654	        or set(endpoints) != {"pre", "post"}
   655	    ):
   656	        return None
   657	    resolved: list[LedgerObservation] = []
   658	    for role in ("pre", "post"):
   659	        endpoint = endpoints.get(role)
   660	        observation = session.finalized_slots.get(role)
   661	        if (
   662	            not isinstance(endpoint, Mapping)
   663	            or set(endpoint) != _BRACKET_ENDPOINT_KEYS
   664	            or observation is None
   665	            or observation.disposition != "valid"
   666	            or observation.content_id is None
   667	            or endpoint.get("attempt_id") != observation.attempt_id
   668	            or endpoint.get("receipt_digest") != observation.receipt_digest
   669	            or endpoint.get("content_digest") != observation.content_id
   670	        ):
   671	            return None
   672	        resolved.append(observation)
   673	    post = resolved[1]
   674	    if (
   675	        terminal.get("sequence") != post.sequence
   676	        or terminal.get("head_digest") != post.receipt_digest
   677	        or post.sequence > len(ledger_snapshot.receipts)
   678	        or ledger_snapshot.receipts[post.sequence - 1].get("receipt_digest")
   679	        != post.receipt_digest
   680	    ):
   681	        return None
   682	    return resolved[0], resolved[1]

   685	def _binding_evidence_authentic(
   686	    evidence: Mapping[str, Any], bindings: Mapping[str, Any]
   687	) -> bool:
   688	    binding_evidence = evidence.get("binding_evidence")
   689	    binary = (
   690	        binding_evidence.get("powermetrics_binary")
   691	        if isinstance(binding_evidence, Mapping)
   692	        else None
   693	    )
   694	    power_policy = (
   695	        binding_evidence.get("power_policy")
   696	        if isinstance(binding_evidence, Mapping)
   697	        else None
   698	    )
   699	    # Canonical form MUST match the generation (powermetrics_fiducial) and
   700	    # reduce-side consumers byte-for-byte: ensure_ascii=False (delta-review
   701	    # P2 — the ASCII-default form made authentic non-ASCII binding vectors
   702	    # unmatchable as bracket candidates).
   703	    canonical = json.dumps(
   704	        dict(bindings),
   705	        sort_keys=True,
   706	        separators=(",", ":"),
   707	        ensure_ascii=False,
   708	        allow_nan=False,
   709	    ).encode("utf-8")
   710	    return bool(
   711	        isinstance(binding_evidence, Mapping)
   712	        and binding_evidence.get("schema_version")
   713	        == "joulewise.instrument_binding_evidence.v1"
   714	        and binding_evidence.get("binding_vector_sha256")
   715	        == hashlib.sha256(canonical).hexdigest()
   716	        and isinstance(binary, Mapping)
   717	        and binary.get("sha256") == bindings.get("powermetrics_sha256")
   718	        and isinstance(binary.get("path"), str)
   719	        and bool(binary.get("path"))
   720	        and isinstance(power_policy, Mapping)
   721	        and power_policy.get("id") == bindings.get("power_policy")
   722	    )

   725	def load_calibration_candidate(
   726	    directory: Path, *, runs_root: Path
   727	) -> CalibrationCandidate | None:
   728	    """Authenticate one standalone validation directory from primary bytes."""
   729	
   730	    root = Path(runs_root).resolve()
   731	    try:
   732	        directory = Path(directory).resolve(strict=True)
   733	        relative = directory.relative_to(root).as_posix()
   734	        manifest_raw = (directory / "manifest.json").read_bytes()
   735	        manifest = json.loads(manifest_raw)
   736	    except (OSError, ValueError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
   737	        return None
   738	    artifacts = manifest.get("artifacts") if isinstance(manifest, Mapping) else None
   739	    if (
   740	        not relative
   741	        or not isinstance(artifacts, Mapping)
   742	        or manifest.get("schema_version")
   743	        != "joulewise.instrument_validation_manifest.v1"
   744	    ):
   745	        return None
   746	    members: dict[str, bytes] = {}
   747	    for name, expected in artifacts.items():
   748	        if not isinstance(name, str) or Path(name).is_absolute() or ".." in Path(name).parts:
   749	            return None
   750	        try:
   751	            member = (directory / name).resolve(strict=True)
   752	            member.relative_to(directory)
   753	            raw = member.read_bytes()
   754	        except (OSError, ValueError):
   755	            return None
   756	        if not _valid_sha256(expected) or hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest() != expected:
   757	            return None
   758	        members[name] = raw
   759	    try:
   760	        evidence_raw = members["instrument_evidence.json"]
   761	        events_raw = members["events.jsonl"]
   762	        powermetrics_raw = members["raw/powermetrics.plist"]
   763	        evidence = json.loads(evidence_raw)
   764	    except (KeyError, UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
   765	        return None
   766	    if not isinstance(evidence, Mapping):
   767	        return None
   768	    protocol_id = evidence.get("protocol_id")
   769	    bindings = evidence.get("bindings")
   770	    capture = evidence.get(CAPTURE_TIME_FIELD)
   771	    if (
   772	        protocol_id not in {PROTOCOL_V2_ID, PROTOCOL_ID}
   773	        or evidence.get("schema_version") != "joulewise.instrument_evidence.v1"
   774	        or manifest.get("protocol_id") != protocol_id
   775	        or manifest.get("pulse_count") != protocol_pulse_count(str(protocol_id))
   776	        or not isinstance(bindings, Mapping)
   777	        or any(bindings.get(field) in (None, "") for field in V2_BINDING_FIELDS)
   778	        or not _binding_evidence_authentic(evidence, bindings)
   779	        or bindings.get("pulse_protocol_id") != protocol_id
   780	        or bindings.get("protocol_sha256") != protocol_sha256(str(protocol_id))
   781	        or evidence.get("pulse_count") != protocol_pulse_count(str(protocol_id))
   782	        or evidence.get("anchor_method_version")
   783	        != "powermetrics_native_second_censored_intersection_v1"
   784	        or evidence.get("residual_region_method") != RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
   785	        or not isinstance(
   786	            evidence.get("residual_region_coverage_assumption"), str
   787	        )
   788	        or not evidence.get("residual_region_coverage_assumption")
   789	        or evidence.get("residual_region_coverage_resolution_s")
   790	        != REGION_COVERAGE_RESOLUTION_S
   791	        or evidence.get("max_age_s") != MAX_AGE_S
   792	        or isinstance(capture, bool)
   793	        or not isinstance(capture, int | float)
   794	        or not math.isfinite(float(capture))
   795	        or float(capture) < 0.0
   796	    ):
   797	        return None
   798	    artifact_hashes = evidence.get("artifact_sha256")
   799	    if (
   800	        not isinstance(artifact_hashes, Mapping)
   801	        or artifact_hashes.get("events.jsonl")
   802	        != hashlib.sha256(events_raw).hexdigest()
   803	        or artifact_hashes.get("raw/powermetrics.plist")
   804	        != hashlib.sha256(powermetrics_raw).hexdigest()
   805	    ):
   806	        return None
   807	    try:
   808	        authenticated_capture = capture_wall_time_from_events(events_raw)
   809	        effective_bound = verify_stored_evidence_physics(
   810	            evidence, powermetrics_raw, events_raw
   811	        )
   812	    except (KeyError, TypeError, ValueError):
   813	        return None
   814	    if abs(float(capture) - authenticated_capture) > 1.0:
   815	        return None
   816	    try:
   817	        decimal_evidence = json.loads(
   818	            evidence_raw,
   819	            parse_float=str,
   820	            parse_int=str,
   821	        )
   822	    except (UnicodeDecodeError, json.JSONDecodeError):
   823	        return None
   824	    stored_lexeme = (
   825	        decimal_evidence.get("b_fiducial_s")
   826	        if isinstance(decimal_evidence, Mapping)
   827	        else None
   828	    )
   829	    stored_decimal = _decimal(stored_lexeme)
   830	    if (
   831	        stored_decimal is not None
   832	        and float(stored_decimal) == float(effective_bound)
   833	    ):
   834	        effective_bound_lexeme = stored_lexeme
   835	    else:
   836	        # A physical re-fit can widen beyond the stored scalar. Its returned
   837	        # representation becomes the re-derivation source lexeme; no later
   838	        # acceptance comparison converts that value through binary64 again.
   839	        effective_bound_lexeme = str(float(effective_bound))
   840	    return CalibrationCandidate(
   841	        relative_path=relative,
   842	        manifest_sha256=hashlib.sha256(manifest_raw).hexdigest(),
   843	        evidence_sha256=hashlib.sha256(evidence_raw).hexdigest(),
   844	        protocol_id=str(protocol_id),
   845	        capture_wall_time_s=float(capture),
   846	        b_fiducial_s=effective_bound_lexeme,
   847	        bindings=dict(bindings),
   848	    )

   851	def _candidate_from_observation(
   852	    observation: LedgerObservation,
   853	) -> CalibrationCandidate | None:
   854	    """Authenticate one valid ledger observation from its custody locator."""
   855	
   856	    if observation.disposition != "valid" or observation.content_id is None:
   857	        return None
   858	    custody = Path(observation.custody_locator)
   859	    candidate = load_calibration_candidate(
   860	        custody,
   861	        runs_root=custody.parent.parent,
   862	    )
   863	    if candidate is None:
   864	        return None
   865	    bound = _candidate_decimal(candidate)
   866	    receipt_bound = _decimal(observation.exact_bound_lexeme_s)
   867	    try:
   868	        receipt_capture = float(observation.capture_wall_time_s)
   869	    except (TypeError, ValueError):
   870	        return None
   871	    if (
   872	        candidate.manifest_sha256
   873	        != observation.artifact_sha256.get("manifest.json")
   874	        or candidate.evidence_sha256
   875	        != observation.artifact_sha256.get("instrument_evidence.json")
   876	        or content_id_from_artifact_hashes(observation.artifact_sha256)
   877	        != observation.content_id
   878	        or bound is None
   879	        or receipt_bound is None
   880	        or bound != receipt_bound
   881	        or candidate.capture_wall_time_s != receipt_capture
   882	        or any(
   883	            candidate.bindings.get(field) != observation.t1_bindings.get(field)
   884	            for field in V2_BINDING_FIELDS
   885	        )
   886	        or any(
   887	            candidate.bindings.get(field) != observation.identity_epoch.get(field)
   888	            for field in ACCEPTANCE_IDENTITY_FIELDS
   889	        )
   890	    ):
   891	        return None
   892	    return replace(
   893	        candidate,
   894	        relative_path=observation.custody_locator,
   895	        attempt_id=observation.attempt_id,
   896	        content_id=observation.content_id,
   897	        ledger_receipt_digest=observation.receipt_digest,
   898	        bracket_session_id=observation.bracket_session_id,
   899	        bracket_slot=observation.bracket_slot,
   900	        bracket_window_id=observation.bracket_window_id,
   901	        bracket_plan_id=observation.bracket_plan_id,
   902	        bracket_plan_sha256=observation.bracket_plan_sha256,
   903	        bracket_evidence_root_id=observation.bracket_evidence_root_id,
   904	    )

   907	def discover_calibration_candidates(
   908	    ledger_snapshot: CalibrationLedgerSnapshot,
   909	) -> tuple[CalibrationCandidate, ...]:
   910	    """Enumerate valid endpoints from the sole ledger authority.
   911	
   912	    The mechanism closes workflow omission, unregistered evidence, and
   913	    rollback/stale-head consumption; it does not defend against a malicious
   914	    trusted writer or a rewrite of both Git and full ledger history.
   915	    """
   916	
   917	    if (
   918	        not isinstance(ledger_snapshot, CalibrationLedgerSnapshot)
   919	        or not ledger_snapshot.valid
   920	        and not ledger_snapshot.is_governed_open_bracket_extension
   921	    ):
   922	        return ()
   923	    candidates: list[CalibrationCandidate] = []
   924	    for observation in ledger_snapshot.observations:
   925	        if observation.disposition != "valid" or observation.is_historical_import:
   926	            continue
   927	        candidate = _candidate_from_observation(observation)
   928	        if candidate is None:
   929	            return ()
   930	        candidates.append(candidate)
   931	    return tuple(candidates)

   910	    """Enumerate valid endpoints from the sole ledger authority.
   911

   930	        candidates.append(candidate)

   934	def _prior_set_matches_import_cutoff_prefix(
   935	    artifact: Mapping[str, Any],
   936	    ledger_snapshot: CalibrationLedgerSnapshot,
   937	) -> bool:
   938	    """Bind issuance prior-set data to the import-marked cutoff prefix."""
   939	
   940	    cutoff = artifact["ledger_cutoff"]
   941	    prefix = tuple(
   942	        observation
   943	        for observation in ledger_snapshot.observations
   944	        if observation.sequence <= cutoff["sequence"]
   945	    )
   946	    # The checked-in schema fixture predates issuance and deliberately has a
   947	    # genesis cutoff. Production issuance, or any fixture containing imported
   948	    # prefix rows, must satisfy the exact marker-bound comparison below.
   949	    if not prefix and artifact.get("artifact_role") == "schema_fixture_unissued":
   950	        return True
   951	    if any(not observation.is_historical_import for observation in prefix):
   952	        return False
   953	    catalog = artifact["prior_observation_set"]["epoch_catalog"]
   954	    expected = {
   955	        (
   956	            row["attempt_id"],
   957	            row["content_id"],
   958	            row["disposition"],
   959	            row["epoch_id"],
   960	        )
   961	        for row in artifact["prior_observation_set"]["observations"]
   962	    }
   963	    observed: set[tuple[str, str, str, str]] = set()
   964	    for observation in prefix:
   965	        epoch_ids = [
   966	            epoch_id
   967	            for epoch_id, epoch in catalog.items()
   968	            if dict(epoch) == dict(observation.identity_epoch)
   969	        ]
   970	        if observation.content_id is None or len(epoch_ids) != 1:
   971	            return False
   972	        observed.add(
   973	            (
   974	                observation.attempt_id,
   975	                observation.content_id,
   976	                observation.classification_disposition,
   977	                epoch_ids[0],
   978	            )
   979	        )
   980	    return observed == expected and len(observed) == len(prefix)

   111	
   112	## Findings
   113	
   114	### F1 — Live-ledger bookending is not yet armable (blocker)
   115	
   116	D-116’s issued ledger is the correct trust root, and D-117 correctly requires fresh live pre/post observations. The obstacle is mechanical: the present append path requires the physical ledger head to match the committed pin when reserving an attempt. Once the pre observation is finalized, that equality no longer holds for an ordinary post reservation.
   117	
   118	The best design is an atomic `calibration_window_bracket_session.v1` capability:
   119	
   120	1. At the pre-bookend, under a clean committed head, append one receipt reserving exactly two immutable slots: `pre` and `post`, each with its attempt ID, plan ID/SHA, evidence-root ID, expected time role, and shared session ID.
   121	2. Finalize the pre slot before member one.
   122	3. Leave the post slot prospectively open without treating it as an unresolved candidate or permitting claim evaluation.
   123	4. Finalize or explicitly abort the post slot at the closing bookend.
   124	5. Commit the terminal ledger head once, then issue an exact `calibration_bracket_binding.v1` mapping the frozen plan and evidence root to the two finalized content/receipt digests.
   125	6. Candidate discovery still examines the complete live candidate universe; the binding selects the claimed pair but cannot hide extra candidates.
   126	
   127	This is preferable to a source commit after the pre observation: that would mutate the repository and readiness head inside every quiet-window procedure. Two ordinary reservations appended in advance are also inferior because the outstanding post reservation would look unresolved unless ledger semantics were widened anyway.
   128	
   129	Base plans should freeze calibration retry count at zero. A failed pre observation aborts before member one and closes the unused post slot; a failed post makes the physical attempt non-claim-bearing. If the lead wants one cause-removal retry, the session capability needs additional prospectively numbered slots and deterministic selection semantics before freeze—never an improvised retry.
   130	
   131	Ideal no-failure receipt evolution from the issued sequence-76 head is three receipts per window—session capability, pre finalization, post finalization—ending at sequence 85 after all three windows. Exact sequence numbers are arm-time facts, not desk-frozen plan literals.
   132	
   133	### F2 — The mint path needs a real v2, not another widened literal list (blocker)
   134	
   135	The current mechanism is `scripts/floor_mint_pinsets/mint1.json` plus `scripts/mint_floor_artifact_generalized.py`. It already embodies the right principle—plans supply hard pins and the mint compares rather than derives—but it remains structurally limited:
   136	
   137	- one plan and one artifact cell;
   138	- `phase_energy_j.decode` only;
   139	- `["phase","decode"]` only;
   140	- no aggregate artifact over independently collected plans.
   141	
   142	D-095 requires one multi-cell floor artifact whose 1.5B and 7B cells remain independently stack-scoped. D-117 adds prefill cells to both floor plans. The correct closure is therefore one four-cell artifact, not two loosely associated artifacts:
   143	
   144	| Cell | Producer | Metric | Scientific family |
   145	|---|---|---|---|
   146	| 1.5B decode | 1.5B floor plan | `phase_energy_j.decode` | existing `df-ph-decode` |
   147	| 1.5B prefill rider | 1.5B floor plan | `phase_energy_j.prefill` | new exact rider family |
   148	| 7B decode | 7B floor plan | `phase_energy_j.decode` | D-085 `df-ph-decode-qwen25-7b` |
   149	| 7B prefill rider | 7B floor plan | `phase_energy_j.prefill` | new exact rider family |
   150

+                }
+                for slot in ledger_module.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,

+
+    def _lifecycle(
+        self,
+        ledger: Path,
+        pin: Path,
+        epoch: dict,
+        t1: dict,
+        custody: dict[str, Path],
+        slot: str,
+    ) -> validation_script._CaptureLedgerLifecycle:
+        return validation_script._CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+            ledger_path=ledger,
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            attempt_id=f"session-writer-{slot}",
+            custody_locator=str(custody[slot]),
+            identity_epoch=epoch,
+            t1_bindings=t1,
+            session_id="session-writer",
+            slot=slot,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger

+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()
