+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()

new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8903b1ac38d416ad00e62fe2f4bc63799e3be2f3
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/u1_adversarial_probes.py
@@ -0,0 +1,152 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()

+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()

diff --git a//tmp/u1_adversarial_probes.py b//tmp/u1_adversarial_probes.py
new file mode 100644
index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..8903b1ac38d416ad00e62fe2f4bc63799e3be2f3
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/u1_adversarial_probes.py
@@ -0,0 +1,152 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+def issued_prefix_probe():
+    source = Path("docs/process_traces/2026-08-06-d079-issuance-coldgate/ISSUANCE-execute-summary.json")
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in source.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    receipts = [row["receipt"] for row in rows if row.get("record") == "receipt"]
+    payload = b"".join(ledger.canonical_json_bytes(receipt) + b"\n" for receipt in receipts)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-issued-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        ledger_path.write_bytes(payload)
+        write_pin(pin, 76, "08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7")
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path,
+            pin,
+            baseline_sequence=76,
+            baseline_digest="08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7",
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+            verify_custody=False,
+        )
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX", len(receipts), snapshot.head_sequence, snapshot.head_digest, json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()
+    issued_prefix_probe()

+
+

+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",

+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)

+
+

+    path.write_text(json.dumps({

+        "head_digest": digest,

+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:

+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+def issued_prefix_probe():
+    source = Path("docs/process_traces/2026-08-06-d079-issuance-coldgate/ISSUANCE-execute-summary.json")
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in source.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    receipts = [row["receipt"] for row in rows if row.get("record") == "receipt"]
+    payload = b"".join(ledger.canonical_json_bytes(receipt) + b"\n" for receipt in receipts)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-issued-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        ledger_path.write_bytes(payload)
+        write_pin(pin, 76, "08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7")
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path,
+            pin,
+            baseline_sequence=76,
+            baseline_digest="08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7",
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+            verify_custody=False,
+        )
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX", len(receipts), snapshot.head_sequence, snapshot.head_digest, json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()
+    issued_prefix_probe()

codex
The `/tmp` probes reproduced both key outcomes:

- Two synchronized processes both passed `begin()` for the identical reserved pre slot; the ledger remained one line, proving no exclusive claim is recorded at capture start.
- A partial finalization line makes the snapshot malformed and `abort_bracket_session()` itself refuses, so process death during the append can strand the ledger without an append-only recovery path.
- Replaying the D-116 issued receipts produced the exact historical SHA `aa806848…`, sequence 76/head `08456d50…`, with zero refusal reasons under the new parser.

I’m starting the canonical full suite unpiped now.

+    receipts = [row["receipt"] for row in rows if row.get("record") == "receipt"]
+    payload = b"".join(ledger.canonical_json_bytes(receipt) + b"\n" for receipt in receipts)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-issued-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"

+            require_committed_pin=False,

+

+    issued_prefix_probe()

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+def issued_prefix_probe():
+    source = Path("docs/process_traces/2026-08-06-d079-issuance-coldgate/ISSUANCE-execute-summary.json")
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in source.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    receipts = [row["receipt"] for row in rows if row.get("record") == "receipt"]
+    payload = b"".join(ledger.canonical_json_bytes(receipt) + b"\n" for receipt in receipts)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-issued-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        ledger_path.write_bytes(payload)
+        write_pin(pin, 76, "08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7")
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path,
+            pin,
+            baseline_sequence=76,
+            baseline_digest="08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7",
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+            verify_custody=False,
+        )
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX", len(receipts), snapshot.head_sequence, snapshot.head_digest, json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+
+
+def wrong_writer_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-wrong-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="right-session",
+            window_id="right-window",
+            plan_id="right-plan",
+            plan_sha256="c" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="right-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"right-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"right-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        cases = (
+            ("wrong-session", "wrong-session", "pre", "right-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+            ("wrong-slot", "right-session", "post", "right-post", root / "right-post"),
+            ("wrong-attempt", "right-session", "pre", "wrong-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+        )
+        for label, session_id, slot, attempt_id, custody in cases:
+            lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+                ledger_path=ledger_path,
+                head_pin_path=pin,
+                attempt_id=attempt_id,
+                custody_locator=str(custody),
+                identity_epoch=epoch,
+                t1_bindings=t1,
+                session_id=session_id,
+                slot=slot,
+                require_committed_pin=False,
+            )
+            try:
+                lifecycle.begin()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "REFUSED", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+            else:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "ACCEPTED")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()
+    issued_prefix_probe()
+    wrong_writer_probe()

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+def issued_prefix_probe():
+    source = Path("docs/process_traces/2026-08-06-d079-issuance-coldgate/ISSUANCE-execute-summary.json")
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in source.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    receipts = [row["receipt"] for row in rows if row.get("record") == "receipt"]
+    payload = b"".join(ledger.canonical_json_bytes(receipt) + b"\n" for receipt in receipts)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-issued-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        ledger_path.write_bytes(payload)
+        write_pin(pin, 76, "08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7")
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path,
+            pin,
+            baseline_sequence=76,
+            baseline_digest="08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7",
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+            verify_custody=False,
+        )
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX", len(receipts), snapshot.head_sequence, snapshot.head_digest, json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+
+
+def wrong_writer_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-wrong-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="right-session",
+            window_id="right-window",
+            plan_id="right-plan",
+            plan_sha256="c" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="right-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"right-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"right-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        cases = (
+            ("wrong-session", "wrong-session", "pre", "right-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+            ("wrong-slot", "right-session", "post", "right-post", root / "right-post"),
+            ("wrong-attempt", "right-session", "pre", "wrong-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+        )
+        for label, session_id, slot, attempt_id, custody in cases:
+            lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+                ledger_path=ledger_path,
+                head_pin_path=pin,
+                attempt_id=attempt_id,
+                custody_locator=str(custody),
+                identity_epoch=epoch,
+                t1_bindings=t1,
+                session_id=session_id,
+                slot=slot,
+                require_committed_pin=False,
+            )
+            try:
+                lifecycle.begin()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "REFUSED", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+            else:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "ACCEPTED")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()
+    issued_prefix_probe()
+    wrong_writer_probe()

+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():

+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+def issued_prefix_probe():
+    source = Path("docs/process_traces/2026-08-06-d079-issuance-coldgate/ISSUANCE-execute-summary.json")
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in source.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    receipts = [row["receipt"] for row in rows if row.get("record") == "receipt"]
+    payload = b"".join(ledger.canonical_json_bytes(receipt) + b"\n" for receipt in receipts)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-issued-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        ledger_path.write_bytes(payload)
+        write_pin(pin, 76, "08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7")
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path,
+            pin,
+            baseline_sequence=76,
+            baseline_digest="08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7",
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+            verify_custody=False,
+        )
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX", len(receipts), snapshot.head_sequence, snapshot.head_digest, json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+
+
+def wrong_writer_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-wrong-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="right-session",
+            window_id="right-window",
+            plan_id="right-plan",
+            plan_sha256="c" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="right-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"right-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"right-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        cases = (
+            ("wrong-session", "wrong-session", "pre", "right-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+            ("wrong-slot", "right-session", "post", "right-post", root / "right-post"),
+            ("wrong-attempt", "right-session", "pre", "wrong-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+        )
+        for label, session_id, slot, attempt_id, custody in cases:
+            lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+                ledger_path=ledger_path,
+                head_pin_path=pin,
+                attempt_id=attempt_id,
+                custody_locator=str(custody),
+                identity_epoch=epoch,
+                t1_bindings=t1,
+                session_id=session_id,
+                slot=slot,
+                require_committed_pin=False,
+            )
+            try:
+                lifecycle.begin()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "REFUSED", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+            else:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "ACCEPTED")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()
+    issued_prefix_probe()
+    wrong_writer_probe()

index 0000000000000000000000000000000000000000..984091e6bfe0e26c326d7bf71d362401fb6fe383
--- /dev/null
+++ b//tmp/u1_adversarial_probes.py
@@ -0,0 +1,228 @@
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import hashlib
+import json
+import multiprocessing as mp
+import os
+import tempfile
+from pathlib import Path
+
+from joulewise import calibration_ledger as ledger
+from joulewise.powermetrics_fiducial import PROTOCOL_ID, RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD
+from scripts.validate_powermetrics_fiducial import _CaptureLedgerLifecycle
+
+
+def vectors():
+    epoch = {
+        "os_build": "25F84",
+        "hardware_model": "Mac15,9",
+        "power_policy": "ac_high_power",
+        "sampling_interval_ms": 100,
+        "estimator_revision": RESIDUAL_REGION_METHOD,
+        "pulse_protocol_id": PROTOCOL_ID,
+    }
+    t1 = {field: f"value-{field}" for field in ledger.T1_FIELDS}
+    t1.update(epoch)
+    return epoch, t1
+
+
+def write_pin(path: Path, sequence: int, digest: str):
+    path.write_text(json.dumps({
+        "sequence": sequence,
+        "head_digest": digest,
+        "ledger_schema": ledger.LEDGER_SCHEMA,
+    }) + "\n", encoding="utf-8")
+
+
+def begin_worker(root: str, gate, results):
+    base = Path(root)
+    epoch, t1 = vectors()
+    lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+        ledger_path=base / "ledger.jsonl",
+        head_pin_path=base / "head.json",
+        attempt_id="race-pre",
+        custody_locator=str(base / "race-pre"),
+        identity_epoch=epoch,
+        t1_bindings=t1,
+        session_id="race-session",
+        slot="pre",
+        require_committed_pin=False,
+    )
+    gate.wait()
+    try:
+        lifecycle.begin()
+    except Exception as exc:
+        results.put(("refused", type(exc).__name__, str(exc)))
+    else:
+        results.put(("accepted", os.getpid()))
+
+
+def concurrency_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-race-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="race-session",
+            window_id="race-window",
+            plan_id="race-plan",
+            plan_sha256="a" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="race-root",
+            slots={
+                "pre": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-pre",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-pre"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+                "post": {
+                    "attempt_id": "race-post",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / "race-post"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                },
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        ctx = mp.get_context("fork")
+        gate = ctx.Barrier(3)
+        results = ctx.Queue()
+        workers = [ctx.Process(target=begin_worker, args=(tmp, gate, results)) for _ in range(2)]
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.start()
+        gate.wait()
+        for worker in workers:
+            worker.join(10)
+        observed = [results.get(timeout=2) for _ in workers]
+        print("CONCURRENCY", json.dumps(sorted(observed), sort_keys=True))
+        print("CONCURRENCY_LEDGER_LINES", len(ledger_path.read_bytes().splitlines()))
+
+
+def partial_finalize_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-partial-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        opened = ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="crash-session",
+            window_id="crash-window",
+            plan_id="crash-plan",
+            plan_sha256="b" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="crash-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"crash-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"crash-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        with ledger_path.open("ab") as handle:
+            handle.write(b'{"schema_version":"joulewise.calibration_window_bracket_session.v1"')
+            handle.flush()
+            os.fsync(handle.fileno())
+        write_pin(pin, 1, opened["receipt_digest"])
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path, pin, require_committed_pin=False, verify_custody=False
+        )
+        print("PARTIAL_REFUSALS", json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+        try:
+            ledger.abort_bracket_session(
+                ledger_path, session_id="crash-session", reason="recover-after-crash"
+            )
+        except Exception as exc:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+        else:
+            print("PARTIAL_ABORT accepted")
+
+
+def issued_prefix_probe():
+    source = Path("docs/process_traces/2026-08-06-d079-issuance-coldgate/ISSUANCE-execute-summary.json")
+    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in source.read_text(encoding="utf-8").splitlines()]
+    receipts = [row["receipt"] for row in rows if row.get("record") == "receipt"]
+    payload = b"".join(ledger.canonical_json_bytes(receipt) + b"\n" for receipt in receipts)
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-issued-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        ledger_path.write_bytes(payload)
+        write_pin(pin, 76, "08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7")
+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path,
+            pin,
+            baseline_sequence=76,
+            baseline_digest="08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7",
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+            verify_custody=False,
+        )
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX", len(receipts), snapshot.head_sequence, snapshot.head_digest, json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+
+
+def wrong_writer_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-wrong-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="right-session",
+            window_id="right-window",
+            plan_id="right-plan",
+            plan_sha256="c" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="right-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"right-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"right-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        cases = (
+            ("wrong-session", "wrong-session", "pre", "right-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+            ("wrong-slot", "right-session", "post", "right-post", root / "right-post"),
+            ("wrong-attempt", "right-session", "pre", "wrong-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+        )
+        for label, session_id, slot, attempt_id, custody in cases:
+            lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+                ledger_path=ledger_path,
+                head_pin_path=pin,
+                attempt_id=attempt_id,
+                custody_locator=str(custody),
+                identity_epoch=epoch,
+                t1_bindings=t1,
+                session_id=session_id,
+                slot=slot,
+                require_committed_pin=False,
+            )
+            try:
+                lifecycle.begin()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "REFUSED", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+            else:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "ACCEPTED")
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()
+    issued_prefix_probe()
+    wrong_writer_probe()

+        snapshot = ledger.load_calibration_ledger_snapshot(
+            ledger_path,
+            pin,
+            baseline_sequence=76,
+            baseline_digest="08456d5076c18a9a7f758969b02f5b6f7ad9fcc267dd12e2d3778c22458094d7",
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+            verify_custody=False,
+        )
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX_SHA256", hashlib.sha256(payload).hexdigest())
+        print("ISSUED_PREFIX", len(receipts), snapshot.head_sequence, snapshot.head_digest, json.dumps(snapshot.refusal_reasons))
+
+
+def wrong_writer_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-wrong-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        ledger_path = root / "ledger.jsonl"
+        pin = root / "head.json"
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        write_pin(pin, 0, ledger.GENESIS_DIGEST)
+        ledger.append_bracket_session_receipt(
+            ledger_path,
+            session_id="right-session",
+            window_id="right-window",
+            plan_id="right-plan",
+            plan_sha256="c" * 64,
+            evidence_root_id="right-root",
+            slots={
+                role: {
+                    "attempt_id": f"right-{role}",
+                    "custody_locator": str(root / f"right-{role}"),
+                    "identity_epoch": epoch,
+                    "t1_bindings": t1,
+                }
+                for role in ledger.BRACKET_SESSION_SLOTS
+            },
+            head_pin_path=pin,
+            require_committed_pin=False,
+        )
+        cases = (
+            ("wrong-session", "wrong-session", "pre", "right-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+            ("wrong-slot", "right-session", "post", "right-post", root / "right-post"),
+            ("wrong-attempt", "right-session", "pre", "wrong-pre", root / "right-pre"),
+        )
+        for label, session_id, slot, attempt_id, custody in cases:
+            lifecycle = _CaptureLedgerLifecycle(
+                ledger_path=ledger_path,
+                head_pin_path=pin,
+                attempt_id=attempt_id,
+                custody_locator=str(custody),
+                identity_epoch=epoch,
+                t1_bindings=t1,
+                session_id=session_id,
+                slot=slot,
+                require_committed_pin=False,
+            )
+            try:
+                lifecycle.begin()
+            except Exception as exc:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "REFUSED", type(exc).__name__, str(exc))
+            else:
+                print("WRONG_WRITER", label, "ACCEPTED")
+
+
+def dry_run_validation_probe():
+    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix="u1-cli-") as tmp:
+        root = Path(tmp)
+        epoch, t1 = vectors()
+        epoch_path = root / "epoch.json"
+        t1_path = root / "t1.json"
+        epoch_path.write_text(json.dumps(epoch), encoding="utf-8")
+        t1_path.write_text(json.dumps(t1), encoding="utf-8")
+        argv = [
+            "--ledger", str(root / "ledger.jsonl"),
+            "--head-pin", str(root / "head.json"),
+            "--session-id", "",
+            "--window-id", "window",
+            "--plan-id", "plan",
+            "--plan-sha256", "d" * 64,
+            "--evidence-root-id", "root",
+            "--pre-attempt-id", "pre",
+            "--post-attempt-id", "post",
+            "--pre-custody-locator", str(root / "pre"),
+            "--post-custody-locator", str(root / "post"),
+            "--identity-epoch-json", str(epoch_path),
+            "--t1-bindings-json", str(t1_path),
+        ]
+        print("DRY_RUN_EMPTY_SESSION_RC", reserve_cli.main(argv))
+
+
+if __name__ == "__main__":
+    concurrency_probe()
+    partial_finalize_probe()
+    issued_prefix_probe()
+    wrong_writer_probe()
+    dry_run_validation_probe()
